summary: Carded the one-master-template migration + GC pass that FLUX.2 Klein (MPI-354) proved.

Brief added: authored wf_type maps for Klein/Krea2/Qwen, Krea2 Input_Tier int -> Input_turbo bool, mask on all three edit ops, crop-independent non-t2i/i2i ops, depth becomes an image LINE, new ControlNet pose op, and the poseReference-means-depth naming collision.

Krea2 + Qwen migrated to the one-master-template shape; poseReference renamed to depth and pose added. Code complete, 302/302 tests green, release:check passed. Maturity validating - NO live generation has been run yet.

Live verification COMPLETE for the migrated models: Krea2 (six ops, both cards), Qwen (edit/depth/pose) and Klein all pass in the app on its own engine, masked edit included. Three defects found and fixed on the way (qwenTier per-op tier reset, mask exported at the MASK_MAX_EDGE-capped size and killing InpaintCropImproved, Klein wf_type never rebaked), plus a Depth Strength slider added for Krea2 and Klein. Maturity validating -> in-progress: SDXL is still to migrate and the user confirmed it belongs to this card. Boogu is NOT in scope (already one file).

CHROMA MIGRATED (commits 2325ae42 generator, 9385120f raw, d33e762e wiring). Six runtime files -> two. User authored the master graph; wf_type 1 t2i / 2 i2i / 3 depth / 6 detail / 7 upscale, 4+5 dead to match Klein+Krea2. TIER IS A FILE AXIS, NOT A RUNTIME ONE: Flash and Hyper are two SEPARATE checkpoints (17GB bf16 vs 9.2GB int8), not weight+accelerator-LoRA like Krea2, so generate_chroma.py bakes ClownModelLoader.model_name + Input_Tier per output (tier 2 Flash -> chroma_t2i.json, tier 3 Hyper -> chroma_hyper_t2i.json), Boogu-style. Two loaders in ONE graph would force BOTH downloads - ComfyUI validates every combo widget at submit time even on a lazily-skipped branch (execution.py value_not_in_list). Tier 1 (High) reserved, never shipped: MPI-217 tested and rejected the full weight. NOTE the loader is RES4LYF ClownModelLoader (model+CLIP in one node), NOT UNETLoader - it is untitled, so the generator looks it up by class_type and asserts exactly one. DEPTH IS NEW AND SHIPS VIA A FLUX CONTROLNET. Chroma is pruned FLUX.1-schnell: its forward pass applies control residuals exactly as FLUX does (comfy/ldm/chroma/model.py:221-226 + :257-262), latent_format is Flux, and Shakker-Labs Union Pro 2.0 x_embedder is [3072,64] = Chroma hardcoded in_channels (model_detection.py:294). NO Chroma-native ControlNet or depth LoRA exists - Klein refcontrol LoRA and Krea2 control-LoRA are both model-specific and neither ports (Krea2 expands img_in, dimension-locked). Union Pro 2.0 DROPPED mode embedding so SetUnionControlNetType is a silent no-op - do not add it. Measured ceiling: strength past ~0.5 artefacts; user normalises 0-1 to 0-0.5 in-graph and runs end_percent 0.570. LICENCE: the ControlNet is the app FIRST non-permissive weight (flux-1-dev-non-commercial). It is linked from HUGGINGFACE, never mirrored to R2 - BFL paid commercial terms STILL forbid distributing to third parties by any means, so no price unblocks rehosting. Linking the origin is the ComfyUI/Invoke/Fooocus position. Consequences: no mirror fallback (_mirrorUrlsFor preserves pathname, HF has no R2 twin) and the sha256 is the only guard against upstream re-upload. No ControlNet exists for Apache-2.0 FLUX.1-schnell, so there is no permissive alternative. Style rack: 5 LoRAs on ONE bank, live on every op (styleOps full reach). imageSizedOps = detail+upscale ONLY - Chroma depth still reads Input_Width/Height through MpiCrop and generates at our dimensions, unlike Klein image-derived depth. New deps: ComfyUI-Impact-Pack (MaskDetailerPipe) + comfyui_controlnet_aux (DepthAnythingV2, weight already shared with Klein). Tests 310/310, validator clean, eslint clean. TWO GATES BEFORE RELEASE: (1) R2 upload of the 5 style LoRAs (1.02GB, hashes recorded, URLs 404 until then); (2) SHA256 licence check vs CivitAI for all 5 (needs VPN) per docs/models/klein/licences.md, plus a credit block for any allowNoCredit:false. STILL OPEN on this card: krea2 + qwen dangling Set/Get blockers, poseReference->depth rename, pose op. Chroma has NO progressStages entries (pre-existing, unmeasured) and no docs/models/chroma/ doc.

Licence gate CLOSED. The documented CivitAI method was incomplete: the v1 API carries no licence field, so the Apache-2.0 badge on two weights was invisible and they read as RentCivit-only. Four style LoRAs ship; chroma-style-cinema was DROPPED for withholding Image and the master template was re-exported to renumber the rack to four. Three credit blocks added. New doc docs/models/chroma/licences.md; klein/licences.md gained the trap; sweep carded as MPI-430. R2 upload of 962 MiB running.

Brief healed. The 4 dangling-Set BLOCKER is struck through: all four were settled by design during the migration (krea2 stops at two images, Qwen bypassed Width/Height and has no i2i denoise), proven by zero unconsumed Input_ nodes in either runtime graph; only cosmetic GC of nine dead raw-template nodes remains. Status section rewritten: Klein/Krea2/Qwen/Chroma migrated and Chroma fully closed out, but the card CANNOT close - SDXL (5 models, 3 files each) and the video models are unmigrated, so the GC acceptance items (shared-op injectParams, the REPLACE-not-merge branch, DEFAULT_STYLE_OPS) all still have live consumers, verified present today.
